title: Composition of Walk Distributions
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of positive degree $D$ on a finite vertex set, let $p$ assign a rational weight to each vertex, and let $a,b$ be nonnegative integers. The distribution obtained by walking for $a+b$ steps from $p$ equals the distribution obtained by first walking for $a$ steps and then walking for $b$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: Regular multigraph of positive degree D
